caption: The drawing depicts a single male figure dressed in elaborate Renaissance-style clothing, standing against a plain, deep blue background. The figure's clothing is primarily light or off-white in color, including a doublet with puffed sleeves, a short skirt-like garment over fitted hose, and pointed shoes. He wears a flat, brimmed hat adorned with a feather, and his curled hair and facial hair (mustache and goatee) are detailed. The man has a chain with a pendant around his neck and a sash around his waist. His left arm is bent at the elbow, holding a scroll, while his right arm hangs loosely at his side. The figure is seen in a three-quarter stance, looking slightly upwards and to his left. There are no other objects or elements in the composition aside from the man and the monochrome background.
title: Figurehead
